title: Residue disposition register -- the evidence a cleanup DECISION is made from, never a cleanup act. Prototyped on the W3b news subsystem; authored to be EXTENDED by the portal-wide artifact sweep (CTO~Z design note 195708Z, sweep spec @1e173e7a00).
description: AUTHORING RULE, applied to every column below: 'would this column mean something for a /valuations residue row?' If no, it is EXTENSION, not core. A schema prototyped on one domain carries that domain's assumptions silently -- this one is prototyped on news and must not encode news. Core is domain-neutral by construction; news-specific fields live in extensions.news and are invisible to a consumer that does not know what news is.

scope.description: EVERY REGISTER DECLARES ITS UNIVERSE. The sweep widens this field and nothing else -- that is the whole point of the prototype.

universe.description: what set this register claims to cover, e.g. 'news subsystem (W3b)' or 'all portal-served artifacts'

declared_at.description: when the universe was fixed -- a register whose universe drifted mid-authoring has no denominator

widens_to.description: the named successor universe, or 'none'. Makes the prototype relationship explicit rather than remembered.

denominator.description: FILE-BACKED, ALWAYS. Three of my own measurement defects this program came from a count that was a recollection or a summary rather than a derivation. The register cannot state a universe size it cannot point at.

enumeration_artifact.description: path to the PERSISTED full set the counts derive from (enumerate_set.py output). Not a command -- a file.

unreconciled.description: if rows_present != universe_size, why -- an unexplained gap reads as coverage

residue_row.description: CORE IS DOMAIN-NEUTRAL. Every field here answers a question that is equally meaningful for a frozen /valuations twin, an orphaned news keyword family, or an unreferenced terraform module.

locator.description: the FULL KEY PATH or fully-qualified identifier -- never a basename. CVO~Z's W1 ruling: a basename-keyed row silently merges two different artifacts, measured twice in this program (two aum-metrics.json in different trees; two valuation_data.json).

residue_class.description: MECE over what residue IS, not over what to do about it (Rule 24 iii -- one axis, one intent; disposition is a SEPARATE field precisely so state and remedy do not share an axis). FROZEN-CONSUMED vs -UNCONSUMED is the split that matters most: a frozen artifact nothing reads is inert, a frozen artifact something still reads is a live exposure -- the /market fallback is the type specimen. LIVE-NOT-RESIDUE added 2026-08-11 BY POPULATING THIS SCHEMA: the W3b register had to account for 2 live keys to close its 722 denominator, and the enum -- designed for residue -- had no honest class for a healthy artifact. I had classified them FROZEN-CONSUMED, which is FALSE (they were written hours earlier). A register that cannot say 'this one is fine' forces a wrong class onto every healthy artifact it must count, and the portal-wide sweep will contain vastly more healthy artifacts than residue. Found by USING the prototype, which is what a prototype is for.

evidence.description: The same claim contract the rectangles use. A residue row is a CLAIM and carries its instrument, or it is not citable.

last_written_utc.description: null where the artifact is ABSENT -- absence is a state, not a missing measurement

age_basis.description: HOW the age was scored -- against the artifact's OWN declared cadence, never wall-clock. CLAUDE.md NEVER#1: resolve the calendar first; a cadence-consistent 'stale' value is an EXPECTED non-finding.

consumed_by.description: consumers grounded at the CONSUMED end (Rule 12), PER CALL SITE and per fetch path (K8). An empty array is a CLAIM requiring evidence, not a default.

disposition.description: ⚠ EVERY VALUE IS A RECOMMENDATION TO A DECIDER, NOT AN ACT. The register is the evidence Andrew's cleanup decision reads FROM; nothing here authorises deletion, movement or repair. Rule 9: nothing is deleted before replacement, parity, cutover, drain, rollback and absence proof -- none of which a register can establish. OWNED-UNKNOWN is a first-class answer and must name its discriminator.

disposition_basis.description: why THIS disposition and not the adjacent one. Where two readings fit the evidence equally and have OPPOSITE remedies, the honest value is OWNED-UNKNOWN with the discriminator named -- guessing laundres a coin-flip into a register a human will act on.

discriminator.description: REQUIRED in practice when disposition is OWNED-UNKNOWN: the observation that would resolve it

blast.description: what breaks if the disposition is enacted -- the question a decider actually needs answered and the one a residue list without it silently omits

reversibility.description: an irreversible act on residue needs a different approval than a reversible one; conflating them is how a cleanup becomes an incident

owner.description: the seat the disposition routes to; NOT-MINE rows must carry one

extensions.description: NAMESPACED, DOMAIN-SPECIFIC. Nothing here may be required by a consumer of the core. The test that put a field here rather than above: 'would this mean something for a /valuations residue row?'

news.description: W3b-specific. A portal-wide sweep consumer ignores this block entirely.

family_member_count.description: for slug-parameterised families carried as ONE row with family grammar
